title: 12 Essential Data Structures Every Programmer Must Know 🚀 | DSA for Coding Interviews
description:
Master the 12 most important Data Structures every programmer should know! 🚀

In this visual guide, you'll learn the foundations of Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA) used in coding interviews, LeetCode, competitive programming, and software engineering.

📚 Covered in this video:
📦 Array
🔗 Linked List
📚 Stack
🚶 Queue
🗂️ Hash Map
🔢 Matrix
↔️ Deque
🌳 Binary Tree
🌲 Binary Search Tree (BST)
⛰️ Heap
🔤 Trie
🕸️ Graph
Why these data structures matter:
✅ Build a strong DSA foundation
✅ Solve LeetCode problems efficiently
✅ Prepare for FAANG and product-based company interviews
✅ Improve problem-solving skills
✅ Understand advanced algorithms with confidence

Whether you're a beginner or preparing for technical interviews, mastering these core data structures is the first step toward becoming a better programmer.

If you enjoy visual DSA explanations, don't forget to Like, Subscribe, and Share for more interview-focused content!
